title: Susan Crawford on Captive Audience: The Telecom Industry & Monopoly Power in the New Gilded Age
channel: Berkman Klein Center for Internet & Society
summary: Susan Crawford talks at Harvard's Berkman Klein Center about her book Captive Audience. She argues that deregulation and consolidation left a few telecom companies in control of American internet access, so people pay too much for slow service.
why: Recommended in broadband and net neutrality threads as an overview of the US telecom monopoly problem.

quote.text: It goes over the telecom industry, how it's not competitive and the current day incentives/problems.
